entities.name: Thomas Andrew Donnellan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas Andrew Donnellan was an American prelate of the Catholic Church who served as the ninth bishop of the Diocese of Ogdensburg in New York State from 1964 to 1968, and as the second archbishop of the Archdiocese of Atlanta in Georgia from 1968 until his death.
